Anslo Design Group (ADG) | Woodland Park, Colorado
About the Position
Anslo Design Group is a small, independently owned architecture firm seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Architectural Drafter to join our team on a part-time, in-office basis.
This is an opportunity to work directly with the firm's principal architect on a diverse range of commercial, custom residential, and high-performance residential projects. As a small firm, you'll have the opportunity to participate in projects from early design through construction documentation while developing a broad understanding of architectural practice.
We are looking for someone with strong Autodesk Revit skills, solid architectural drafting fundamentals, interest in passive house/environmental, and prior experience working in a professional architecture firm. The ideal candidate takes pride in producing quality work, communicates effectively, and is comfortable working independently in a small-office environment.
Schedule: Approximately 20–30 hours per week, with a consistent schedule mutually agreed upon with the principal architect.
Compensation: $22–$26 per hour, depending on experience.
Employment: Part-time W-2 Employee
Responsibilities
Develop and maintain architectural drawings and construction documents using Autodesk Revit.
Assist with design development and construction documentation for commercial and residential projects.
Produce architectural plans, elevations, building sections, details, and schedules.
Assist with wall sections, building assemblies, and construction detailing.
Coordinate architectural drawings with structural, mechanical, electrical, and civil consultants.
Assist with project organization, model management, and general drawing standards.
Contribute to the development of sustainable, energy-efficient, and passive house building designs and the PHIUS certification process.
Assist with marketing efforts for the company that include designing advertisements, holiday gifts, assisting with event booths and trade shows, and continually building, developing and growing vendor and client relationships.
Help maintain a clean, organized, and professional office environment through routine office upkeep.
Qualifications
Minimum of one year of professional experience working in an architectural firm or similar design environment.
An architectural degree or relevant technical education is required.
Strong working knowledge of Autodesk Revit, Enscape, and Microsoft Office Suite. Working knowledge in Adobe Creative Suite and sketch-up
Positive, proactive attitude with a willingness to learn, grow, take initiative, and independently carry ideas and assignments through to completion.
Solid understanding of architectural drafting standards and construction documentation.
Familiarity with building construction, materials, assemblies, and architectural detailing.
Ability to read and interpret architectural drawings and consultant documents.
Strong written and verbal communication skills; works well in a team environment.
Ability to work independently, take direction, and manage assigned tasks.
Valid Drivers License required
Professional Expectations
A passion for design, construction, architecture and other outside interests that feed your soul.
Maintain a consistent and dependable work schedule, including punctuality and regular attendance.
Take ownership of assigned tasks and work efficiently to meet established project deadlines.
Maintain a high level of accuracy, organization, and attention to detail in all drawing production.
Be receptive to feedback, redlines, and direction while demonstrating the ability to work independently.
Maintain a professional, collaborative, and positive attitude when working with the principal architect, consultants, and project team members.
Take pride in producing quality work and contributing to the overall success of the firm.
What We Offer
Direct mentorship and collaboration with the firm's principal architect.
Exposure to a diverse portfolio of commercial and custom residential projects.
Opportunities to develop experience in sustainable design, high-performance building assemblies, and passive house design and the certification process through PHIUS.
Flexible part-time schedule in a small, collaborative office environment. Opportunity for increased hours, potential transition to full-time employment, and expanded benefits as the firm grows.
Support and guidance toward ARE examinations and NCARB licensure requirements. Financial assistance available after the first three months of employment.
Opportunities for periodic bonuses recognizing exceptional performance, initiative, and contributions that support the firm's growth and overall success.
How to Apply
Please submit a resume, a brief summary of your Revit experience, and samples of architectural construction documents or project work. Examples should include wall sections, enlarged details, or other construction drawings that demonstrate your understanding of building assemblies, materials, construction detailing as well as creative work/ideas.
Anslo Design Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Anslo Design Group will provide equal opportunity to all individuals without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, and disability or veteran status.
